I replied to Pree in our DM: from now on, Linnea Merriwether is her escalation contact at Marrow Agrisupply for the Tamarack rollout. I told her it stays between the two of us.

I didn't save a separate note. Her DM is already stored in the workspace brain automatically, and only she can see it there. A separate note might not keep that limit, and the contact could reach other people.
